mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_log (product_id, change_type, change_quantity, before_stock, after_stock, related_order_no, operator_id, remark) VALUES (#{productId}, #{changeType}, #{changeQuantity}, #{beforeStock}, #{afterStock}, #{relatedOrderNo}, #{operatorId}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT il.*, p.name AS product_name, u.real_name AS operator_name FROM inventory_log il LEFT JOIN product p ON il.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON il.operator_id = u.id WHERE il.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY il.create_time DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%m-%d') AS date, IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS count FROM sales_order WHERE status != 2 AND order_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY order_date ORDER BY order_date

SELECT pc.name AS category_name, SUM(soi.subtotal) AS amount, SUM(soi.quantity) AS quantity FROM sales_order_item soi JOIN sales_order so ON soi.order_id = so.id JOIN product p ON soi.product_id = p.id JOIN product_category pc ON p.category_id = pc.id WHERE so.status != 2 AND so.order_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY pc.id, pc.name ORDER BY amount DESC
